title: 只做自然柔和的眉形吗？
title_en: Do you only design soft, natural-looking brows?
description: 不是。乐乐老师个人审美偏自然柔和、原生态，但会结合五官、原生眉和顾客希望呈现的风格定制，不局限于温柔眉。
description_en: No. Lele personally favours a soft, natural look, but each design responds to the facial features, existing brows and the character the client wants. Her work is not limited to one brow style.

title: 到店设计收费吗？
description: 到店设计免费，约30–45分钟。先讨论基础与风格，把眉形画出来给你看，觉得合适再决定做不做，不做也不收费。
description_en: Yes. The design consultation is free and usually takes 30–45 minutes. Discuss your brows and preferences, see the proposed shape, then decide whether to proceed. There is no charge if you decide not to.

title: 项目价格和补色怎么确认？
title_en: Where can I check prices and touch-up terms?
description: 项目价格以大众点评当期门店信息为准。所有项目一年内免费补色，操作前确认项目与护理安排。
description_en: Check the studio’s current Dianping listing for prices. All services include free touch-ups within one year. The service and aftercare plan are confirmed before treatment.

title: 恢复期和留色时间能保证吗？
title_en: Can recovery time or pigment retention be guaranteed?
description: 不能。恢复表现和留色时间受个人肤质、原有底色、操作及护理等因素影响。门店提供的时间是经验参考，具体以本人恢复情况和到店评估为准。
description_en: No. Skin, existing pigment, the procedure and aftercare can affect healing and retention. Any time estimate is an experience-based guide, not a guaranteed result.

title: 旧眉可以直接重新做吗？
title_en: Can existing brow pigment be worked over?
description: 先看旧底色的深浅、范围和原眉形。底色较深时可能需要先到具备相应资质的机构咨询去色；本店不提供旧色去除服务。
description_en: The depth, extent and shape of existing pigment must be assessed first. Darker residual pigment may need advice on removal from an appropriately qualified provider. This studio does not offer pigment removal.

title: 如何预约到店？
title_en: How do I arrange a visit?
description: 添加微信MiaoMeiHuaMu或致电19282182068，沟通项目与方便到店的时间。乐乐老师本人一对一设计操作，具体时间以回复确认为准。
description_en: Contact the studio on WeChat at MiaoMeiHuaMu or call +86 192 8218 2068 to discuss the service and a suitable time. Lele designs and performs the work personally, one client at a time. An appointment is confirmed by the studio’s reply.
